title: Bestiarium
subtitle: TWO BEASTS · TWO IN WAX · THIRTEEN STONES
description:
Creatures told by hide, silk and weapons, face to palm.
Two beasts in lost wax. Thirteen stones in made settings.
finish: Studio gold · darkened recesses · stones set
sheet_note: Rendered from actual ring geometry. Stones are set at the bench after casting.
footer: Rendered in studio gold from the exported finished-metal meshes, with each reference stone in its own material. Every ring passes its casting gates for lost wax; the investment pattern and reference stones are in each ring's folder. None of these designs has been physically cast.

rings.title: Arachne
rings.subtitle: The weaver
rings.description: A spider clasps the finger at the hub of her own orb web. A garnet carapace and an onyx abdomen sit in collets, eight jointed legs grip the band, and the silk runs round the shoulders to the palm.
rings.spec: Keyframed low dome 5.6 × 2.4 mm · lost wax · onyx 9 × 7 mm and garnet 5 × 3.5 mm oval cabochons

rings.title: Manticora
rings.subtitle: The tail that throws
rings.description: The ring is the manticore's scorpion tail. Graded tergites rise from the palm to a venom bulb where a ruby sits in a beaded collet, the hooked sting curls over the stone, and black spinels run down each shoulder.
rings.spec: Keyframed high dome 5.4 × 2.2 mm · lost wax · ruby 7 × 5 mm oval, ten graded black spinel princesses
